scope: One file, browser pause/reload/reselection, local MinIO, one attempt; not a concurrency or 20-case recovery benchmark

source.generator: AES-256-CTR over zeros; SHA-256(seed) key; zero IV; 4 MiB writes

resources.definition: Chrome sum of process RSS (shared pages can be counted multiple times); Node RSS; Docker memory usage and CPU from docker stats. Samples are not instantaneous allocation maxima.

transfer_definition: Source bytes / sum of first-PUT-to-last-ack windows before pause and after resume; includes signing, acknowledgements and retries, excludes both prehashes, intentional pause/reload, processing and download. Browser request events include intentionally intercepted/unaccepted requests 4..6 before pause.
